shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'pwd && cat ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then cat ../round-brief.md; fi && cat .lore/dod.md'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts'); s=p.read_text(); s=s.replace('      if (hooks?.beforeSession) await hooks.beforeSession(session);\\n\\n      try {','      try {\\n        if (hooks?.beforeSession) await hooks.beforeSession(session);'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'); s=p.read_text(); old='- "'`beforeSession` is inside the `try` block, so a throw there reaches the `catch`/`finally` blocks, firing both `onError` and `afterSession`, where a deployer can assume no tools were run and the turn was aborted before provider interaction ([validated by: runs onError and afterSession when beforeSession throws](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts#L40)).'"\\n'; s=s.replace(old,''); s=s.replace('## Engine startup','- If "'`beforeSession` throws an `Error`, `onError` receives the original session and error ([validated by: passes the original session and error to onError [specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md#6]](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.unit.test.ts#L8)).'"\\n- A failing "'`beforeSession` still rejects to the caller and runs `afterSession`; no user-input hooks, provider calls, or tool rounds have run, and cleanup must tolerate partially completed setup ([validated by: runs onError and afterSession when beforeSession throws](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts#L40)).'"\\n\\n## Engine startup'); s=s.replace('These three properties','These two properties'); p.write_text(s)

PY
 timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.unit.test.ts"
